findings.rule: The pinned tool bundle must match the producer working tree and both consumers must pin the same archive digest
findings.trigger: The pinned archive had been superseded by producer edits, so the executed classifier and gate policy were older than the ledger-tooling working tree
findings.impact: Repositories enforced a stale procedure: CRLF-normalised skill comparison, nested-template rejection, --include= and whole-repository gate detection, command_migrations and stricter step identity were absent from the tool that actually ran
findings.recommendation: Re-bundle and re-pin; verified sha256 5639509aad4db9cd81d98d5918971acf91b6e3fcb4f39d16d50ae73bf6d27906 equals the SHA-256 of tool/ledger-tooling-v0.1.0.tar.gz in both ledger and ledger-app, every archive entry is byte-equal to the ledger-tooling working tree, the archive contains only .go/.md/go.mod source, and tool/bootstrap.go equals the bundled bootstrap/bootstrap.go plus exactly one generated header line

findings.rule: Skill comparison must not treat line-ending conversion as drift
findings.trigger: A core.autocrlf=true checkout materialises unchanged skill content with CRLF endings
findings.impact: skills-check failed for an untouched file, blocking Windows checkouts and inviting the gate to be disabled
findings.recommendation: normalizeEndings now maps CRLF to LF on both sides; reproduced in a /tmp scratch copy: a fully CRLF ledger-debug copy passes (exit 0) both standalone and as a step inside a configured command, while a one-word content change still fails with skill copy has drifted from the pinned template

findings.rule: Published problem kinds must be an enumeration, not a hand-maintained mirror
findings.trigger: A new problem.Kind could be added without any adapter registration while the kind table stayed unchanged
findings.impact: An unregistered kind degraded to a 500 response for clients while the suite stayed green
findings.recommendation: problem.Kinds() plus TestEveryPublishedKindIsRegistered pin the enumeration; in a scratch copy, appending an unpublished constant to Kinds() fails with 16 published kinds but 15 pinned contract entries and deleting the problem.NotFound adapter fails with kind not-found is not registered by the responder; removing problem.Internal is also caught by three other tests

findings.rule: Consumer call sites must track the stricter CLI argument validation
findings.trigger: changes now rejects unknown arguments instead of ignoring them, so the no-longer-supported --json flag would abort CI classification
findings.impact: The classification step would fail and no downstream gate would run on a pull request
findings.recommendation: Verified the flag was dropped from the workflow, that changes still writes JSON to stdout plus --github-output, that the App workflow never passed --json, and that no stale --json reference to this command remains in either repository

findings.rule: A correction round must add gate coverage rather than remove it
findings.trigger: The shared check command was edited in the same change that re-pinned the bundle
findings.impact: An unreviewed removal of a gate step or command would silently weaken the repository gate
findings.recommendation: Compared git show e65d807:governance.json with the working tree: check gained exactly the @ledger-tool skills-check step, and no command, step, threshold, source root, exclusion or baseline field changed; policy-check exits 0

findings.rule: Documentation must not state a wider guarantee than the enforced invariant
findings.trigger: The sentence states that skills-check requires every shared skill under .agents/skills to match the pinned template, while the implementation iterates the bundle templates and never enumerates the consumer skill directory
findings.impact: A consumer-only skill can be rewritten to describe a different procedure and skills-check still passes, so the documented assurance that a repository cannot quietly document a different procedure is not what is enforced
findings.recommendation: Qualify the sentence as the producer docs/contracts.md does (every template in the pinned bundle must exist at .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md byte for byte, and additional consumer-only skills are allowed), or ship a bundle template for the App-only ledger-ui skill; evidence: in a /tmp scratch copy of the App, replacing the ledger-ui procedure with a contradictory instruction leaves skills-check at exit 0 while drifting the templated ledger-debug copy fails
